title: chore(deps): update dependency slash to v4

expectedFindings.description: A bot dependency bump to slash v4, which is pure ESM. plugin-vue loads it with require(), so its dev mode breaks. CI passes only because CI bundles plugin-vue with esbuild.

mustNotSkip.reason: A major-version bump hidden behind lockfile noise; yarn.lock is safe to skip.

evidence.note: Maintainer: "this actually breaks plugin-vue's dev mode since slash 4 is "type": "module" and can no longer be required".
Revert PR: "revert update dependency slash to v4 (#4118)".
